verdict.rationale: Claude Code exposes a documented Agent SDK for building custom agents with full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions, plus CLI scripting/composability (Unix-style piping, CI use) and headless/automation modes, all backed by official docs. This constitutes a genuine programmatic/API surface beyond the interactive CLI, satisfying the ai-native driving-via-API story, though it's SDK/CLI-based rather than a classic REST API.
